items.author: Graham Keeley
items.excerpt: Young people are trapped in the family home or forced to pay high rents for cramped accommodation, at the mercy of landlords. Tens of thousands of young people have protested across Spain in recent weeks, rallying against the country’s acute housing crisis. On Wednesday, many have gone on strike, heeding calls by Spain’s biggest unions for a nationwide walkout under the slogan: “Salarios, vivienda y precios” – or “wages, housing, and prices”. Anger grew last month after the forcible eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal from the Madrid flat where she had lived for the past seven decades.

items.author: Isaac Trotter

The Duke coach was rightfully peeved after No. 5 Michigan State eviscerated the second-ranked Blue Devils 79-73 in a Champions Classic game that was far more one-sided than the final ledger. "That wasn't Duke basketball," Scheyer said matter-of-factly. The steam pouring out of Scheyer's ears was clear as day.
